posts.imageAlt: Grand Prix of Wales announcement for Marcus Kaerup
posts.summary: The 2WD European Champion and current 4WD and 1/8 eBuggy World Champion will compete in both 2WD and 4WD.

posts.imageAlt: Grand Prix of Wales announcement for Ben Smith
posts.summary: The newly crowned double 1/10 National Champion and Schumacher driver will compete in both 2WD and 4WD.

posts.imageAlt: Grand Prix of Wales announcement for Jamie and Tommy Hall
posts.summary: The multiple National-winning Team Associated Hall brothers will both compete in 2WD and 4WD at the Grand Prix of Wales.

posts.imageAlt: Grand Prix of Wales announcement for Craig Drescher
posts.summary: The 11-time European Champion and multiple Worlds A-finalist will compete in both 2WD and 4WD.

posts.imageAlt: Grand Prix of Wales announcement for Jonny Skidmore
posts.summary: The 1/8 eBuggy National Champion, 1/8 Nitro Worlds A-finalist and XRAY driver will compete in both 2WD and 4WD.

posts.imageAlt: Craig Harris and Chris Gunter with their SWORD Winter Series trophies and GPW golden tickets
posts.summary: Craig Harris and Chris Gunter won the SWORD Winter Series and each received a free entry to the Grand Prix of Wales.

posts.imageAlt: Grand Prix of Wales free-entry announcement for Dan Cooper
posts.summary: Dan Cooper won a free Grand Prix of Wales entry in the MKGP raffle.
